metadata.title: Equatorial Pacific
metadata.what_you_will_try: This region stays warm all year. Can you hear the small changes in brightness from step to step?

timeline.accessibility_text: Mar 25, 2007: hot surface water averaging 29.3 degrees Celsius (from 27.0 to 31.1), with steady currents and some swirling eddies. You hear bright, open tones and steady pulses.
timeline.echo_callout: Equatorial Pacific. Each streak is a surface current, coloured from blue at 0 to red at 32 degrees. Listen as the year unfolds.
